AE2's §6Dusts and Materials§f are the foundation for processors, cores, and tools. The key variants:

§6Certus Quartz Dust§f (material:2): grind Certus Quartz Crystal or Ore in a Macerator. §6Nether Quartz Dust§f (material:3): grind vanilla Nether Quartz. §6Fluix Dust§f (material:8): grind a Fluix Crystal.

§6Charged Certus Quartz Crystal§f (material:1): charge a Certus Quartz Crystal in a §6Charger§f. §6Pure Certus Quartz Crystal§f (material:10): grow a Certus Quartz Bud in a §6Crystal Growth Accelerator§f. §6Pure Nether Quartz Crystal§f (material:11): grow a Nether Quartz variant similarly.

§ePS:§f Set up a Macerator farm with both Certus and Nether Quartz Ore to produce dusts in bulk. The §6Quartz Grindstone§f is a cheap early alternative to the Macerator.
